payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scan all rows, columns, diagonals for a window of 5 cells with exactly 4 X's and 1 dot; if found, Alice can win by placing X in the dot.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks every possible 5-cell line (combination of consecutive cells) on the board to see if it contains 4 X's and 1 dot. This is a complete search over all candidate winning lines, akin to enumeration of combinations.
